q: The Fourier expansion of a Boolean function f: {0,1}ⁿ→{±1} satisfies Parseval's identity:
exp: Parseval: ∑_{S⊆[n]} f̂(S)² = E_x[f(x)²] = 1 (since f takes values ±1). The Fourier coefficients are the 'frequencies' of f; Parseval says their total squared norm is 1. The total influence I(f) = ∑_S |S|f̂(S)² measures sensitivity.
